_why: v21 pre-1980 backfill: the 1965-1976 ingredient first-appearance screen can only prove 'first in the committed payloads' while the payloads start in 1965. This block extends the same auditable ORIG+AP+date-in-year filter back to 1939 (start of the Drugs@FDA database) so a molecule marketed before 1965 can be detected instead of being reported as new. Same extraction (scripts/openfda_decisions.py) and the same manifest discipline: raw payloads not committed, every request URL + raw SHA-256 recorded. Drugs@FDA coverage before 1965 is itself incomplete, so this widens the screen without making it proof of first marketing - the builder says so explicitly.
